# Higgsfield Automation - Full AI Reference

Canonical URL: https://www.deepakthapa.dev/higgsfield-automation/
Creator: Deepak Thapa
Product type: Browser extension
Current published Chrome version: 1.0.5
Affiliation: Independent; not affiliated with or endorsed by Higgsfield.

## Summary

Higgsfield Automation runs prompt batches through the Higgsfield image and video pages open in the user's browser. It supports typed and imported prompts, reference-image workflows, retries, pacing, resume behavior, organized downloads, and CSV reports.

## Supported workflows

- Text to Video
- Frame to Video
- Text to Image
- Image to Image

## Prompt and queue features

- Blank-line-separated prompt blocks.
- TXT, CSV, XLS, and XLSX imports.
- Append and replace import behavior.
- Spreadsheet sheet and prompt-column selection.
- Image Batch Size control for image outputs per prompt.
- Repeated submissions for video outputs per prompt.
- Configurable concurrency, pacing, retries, and wait ceilings.
- Prompt chaining with the `>>` prefix.
- Stop and signature-gated resume.
- Batch validation before image-driven runs.

## Downloads and reporting

- Automatic result downloads.
- User-selected Downloads subfolder.
- Multiple filename-source modes.
- Download completion tracking.
- CSV reports containing prompt status, retry stages, output metadata, filenames, and completion information.

## Privacy

- Firebase Authentication handles extension sign-in.
- Prompts and selected reference images are sent to higgsfield.ai only when the user starts the requested workflow.
- The extension does not collect analytics, telemetry, advertising identifiers, or general browsing history.
- Settings and selector configuration are cached in browser extension storage.
- Public product and support pages are hosted at the official deepakthapa.dev product route.
- Selector configuration is hosted on the developer-operated Cloudflare Pages endpoint.
